grid.geoSource: Shapefile depth points; cell-average / discrete Laplace interpolation; ETOPO land mask; N03 2026 land polygons

contourInterpolation.method: cell-average depth points; discrete Laplace for empty cells; nearest initialization; no-flow outer edges
contourInterpolation.landInferenceMethod: N03 2026 polygon union; ETOPO outside coverage

coastline.sampling: 3x3 land fraction; N03 polygon union in covered cells; ETOPO elsewhere
coastline.interpolation: Discrete Laplace on missing water cells; input and ETOPO fixed; no flux across land
coastline.verticalDatum: Not converted; verify source bathymetric datum versus EGM2008 before scientific use

landPolygons.source: MLIT National Land Numerical Information N03 2026
landPolygons.processing: Municipal polygons grouped into 1-degree tiles; attributes removed; coordinates rounded to 1e-7 degrees. JGD2011 used on WGS84 grid without epoch-dependent sub-metre correction.
landPolygons.method: Union of administrative polygons; 3x3 land fraction; measured wet depths fixed; Laplace coastal gaps with zero-depth land edge (minimum wet depth 1 m); ETOPO outside coverage

reconstruction.method: Measured depths fixed; local weighted depth planes; ETOPO coastal support; bounded extrapolation; no neural network
reconstruction.warning: Estimated shoreline, not surveyed; verify tidal datum and coastal geometry before scientific use
